desc:
✈️ Welcome to Airplane 3! We are back in the aereal adventure in which this time we are in command of a military general. It seems he has a mission for you and a couple other soldiers. Will you be able to deal with it or will terrible things happen..?

🔥 Having a hard time surviving? Check out the GAMEPASSES we have to give you a hand!

😎 Join the fan group: https://www.roblox.com/groups/5103418/Ponchokings#!/about 

👍 If you enjoyed the game remember to like and favorite!
